create.name: Fleur Chambers
create.bio:
Fleur Chambers is a Melbourne meditation teacher and author, and the founder of The Happy Habit, a meditation app and set of online programmes. She has a master's degree in adult education, and her teaching grew out of difficult years of her own, which left her convinced that a good life makes room for the hard parts instead of waiting for them to pass. In 2022 she made The Happy Habit a social enterprise, with half of its profits going to grassroots projects on clean water, climate and education in poorer communities.

Her approach is informal and down to earth. She favours very short practices for ordinary moments, such as the drive home or a crowded inbox, walking meditations for people who struggle to sit still, and gentle work on boundaries and self-trust, all framed around caring for the nervous system. Her paid programmes include In the Moment, a set of brief practices for busy days, Walk Yourself Home and The Overgiver's Reset. She has written several books, among them Wholehearted Confidence, and gathered a collection of true stories about daily rituals in North Star Habits. Many of her guided meditations can be heard free on Insight Timer, where she has a large following.

books.title: Wholehearted Confidence: A New Way to Live, Love and Contribute
books.author: Fleur Chambers
books.description: Fleur's book on confidence as a quiet form of self-trust rather than something to be earned or proved. It looks at old stories about worth and how to feel more at ease in yourself and in the way you show up for others.

books.title: North Star Habits: Stories of Finding Your Way Home
books.author: Fleur Chambers
books.description: A collection of seventeen true stories, gathered by Fleur, from writers of many ages and countries about a small ritual or habit that steadied them in a hard season. Proceeds went to a children's library project in Bangladesh.

courses.title: In the Moment
courses.description: Twenty very short guided meditations, five to seven minutes each, made for real situations such as the car after a hard conversation or the end of a crowded day. Bought once with ongoing online access.

courses.title: Walk Yourself Home
courses.description: Seven guided walking meditations, each under twenty minutes, for people who find sitting still hard. Every walk carries one intention and a question to reflect on outdoors.

courses.title: The Overgiver's Reset
courses.description: Five ten-minute video practices on caring for others without overextending yourself. It works with the body's habit of saying yes too quickly and with setting kinder limits.

free_resources.title: Fleur Chambers on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations and short video practices from Fleur, including morning practices and simple resets, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Wholehearted Confidence: free first chapter
free_resources.description: A free sample chapter of Fleur's book on confidence, sent by email when you sign up on her site.

Tier borderline: total ~83.2k (80k-150k band). Insight Timer bio also claims 120,000+ people in her online classrooms and 3 million downloads; no override applied.
